sections.title: Interventionalist Tactics: Writing Off the Page
sections.description: This class functions on one very simple premise: you will be required to write anywhere except for on the page. By studying the theory and practices of situationism, graffiti, and culture jamming, we will explore ways of detourning traditional methods of writing into an act imbued with alternative modes of social, political and aesthetic value. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
